ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (6) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Единение» (edinenie, 'union') is the title; «не я» (ne ya, 'not I') is kept as 'not-I' and «всё я же и я» (vsyo ya zhe i ya, 'still I myself, and I') literally. «Себялюбие» (sebyalyubie) is 'self-love' and «злорадство» (zloradstvo) 'malicious joy' in both places; «состояние духа» (sostoyanie dukha) is 'state of spirit'.
